seo.title: Calendly booking chatbot for WhatsApp and your website | Steps AI
seo.description: Connect Calendly to Steps AI so your agent can book appointments in the chat on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and your website.

hero.title: Book appointments into Calendly from the chat.
hero.body: If you already take bookings with Calendly, your agent can book customers into it from the conversation, on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger or your website.
hero.reassurance: Bookings in your own calendar. The details you ask for. One view of every booking.

lines.text: Can I book a consultation this Thursday?
Thursday has 11:00 or 3:30 free. Which suits you?
You are booked for Thursday at 3:30. A confirmation is on its way.

useCases.title: What you can do with Calendly connected.
useCases.intro: Built for teams that already run their meetings through Calendly, where the agent is measured by the bookings it makes.

items.title: Book from any channel
items.body: Customers book on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger or your website, and the appointment goes into Calendly.

items.title: Collect the details you need
items.body: Choose which details to ask for before a booking, such as name, email, company or job title, and edit the wording.

items.title: Decide when the agent should book
items.body: Describe in plain English when the booking skill should be used, and give examples of when it should not.

items.title: See every booking in one place
items.body: The Calendar screen in Steps AI shows bookings from Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, Calendly, Cal.com and Square Appointments together.

walkthrough.title: From a question to a confirmed booking.
walkthrough.intro: How a booking conversation goes on WhatsApp.

steps.label: Answer the first question
steps.customer: How much is a first consultation?
steps.agent: A first consultation is 45 minutes. Would you like to book one?
steps.note: The agent answers from your own information before suggesting a booking.

steps.label: Offer times
steps.agent: Thursday has 11:00 or 3:30 free. Which suits you?
steps.note: Times come from your connected Calendly.

steps.label: Collect details
steps.agent: Thanks Priya. What email should I send the confirmation to?
steps.note: Only the fields you switched on are asked for.

steps.label: Confirm the booking
steps.agent: You are booked for Thursday at 3:30. See you then.
steps.note: The appointment is added to Calendly and shows in your Steps AI calendar.

setup.title: Connect Calendly in a few minutes.
setup.intro: No code. You sign in to the app once and you choose which agents use it.

items.title: Connect Calendly
items.body: Open Resources, then Apps, and choose Calendly. Sign in, or enter your account details, to connect it to your workspace.

items.title: Add it to your agent
items.body: Connecting adds Calendly to your workspace. Then add it to each agent that should use it. An agent only uses the app once both steps are done.

items.title: Add the booking skill to your agent
items.body: In your agent's skills, switch on Book appointment, choose Calendly as the provider and pick the details to collect.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: Each booking skill uses one calendar provider. You can connect several calendars and choose one per skill.
Booking works best when your calendar shows your real availability, so keep busy times blocked out.

items.a: Steps AI connects with Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, Calendly, Cal.com and Square Appointments.

items.q: Can I use more than one calendar?
items.a: Yes. Connect as many as you need. Each booking skill uses one of them, and the Calendar screen shows all of them together.

items.q: What details does the agent ask for?
items.a: You choose. Name, email, company and job title can each be switched on or off, and you can edit how they are asked.

cta.title: See Steps AI work with Calendly.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through a real conversation using Calendly and your own information.
